verses.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked on, and our hands have handled (touched), of the Word of life,
For the life was manifested (shown), and we have seen it, and bear witness. We show to you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested (shown) to us.

That which we have seen and heard we declare (tell) to you, so that you also may have fellowship (sharing) with us. And truly our fellowship (sharing) is with the Father, and with His Son Jesus Christ.
And these things we write to you, so that your joy may be full.
This then is the message which we have heard from Him, and declare (tell) to you: God is light, and in Him is no darkness at all.
If we say that we have fellowship (sharing) with God, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not do the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as God is in the light, we have fellowship (sharing) with one another. And the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanses us from all sin.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive (fool) ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we confess (admit) our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness (wrong).
If we say that we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and His word is not in us.

1.source: Rewritten 2026-11-21 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses.

verses.text: My little children, I write these things to you so that you do not sin. And if any man sins, we have an advocate (one who speaks for us) with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous (the One who is right).
And Jesus is the propitiation (the sacrifice that turns away God's anger) for our sins. And not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
And by this we know that we know Him, if we keep His commandments.
The one who says, I know Him, and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in that liar.
But whoever keeps His word, in that person truly the love of God is perfected (made complete). By this we know that we are in Him.
The one who says he abides (lives) in Him ought himself also to walk, even as Jesus walked.
Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning.
Again, a new commandment I write to you, which thing is true in Him and in you. Because the darkness is past, and the true light now shines.
The one who says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.
The one who loves his brother abides (lives) in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling (cause to fall) in him.
But the one who hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and does not know where he is going, because that darkness has blinded his eyes.
I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for His name's sake.

I write to you, fathers, because you have known Him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write to you, little children, because you have known the Father.

I have written to you, fathers, because you have known Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides (lives) in you, and you have overcome the wicked one.
Do not love the world, or the things that are in the world. If any man loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
For all that is in the world, the lust (wrong desire) of the flesh, and the lust (wrong desire) of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
And the world passes away, and its lust (wrong desire). But the one who does the will of God abides (lasts) forever.
Little children, it is the last time. And as you have heard that antichrist will come, even now there are many antichrists. By this we know that it is the last time.

They went out from us, but they were not of us. For if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us. But they went out, so that it might be made manifest (shown clearly) that they were not all of us.
But you have an unction (anointing) from the Holy One, and you know all things.
I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
Who is a liar but the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
Whoever denies the Son, the same does not have the Father. But the one who acknowledges (confesses) the Son has the Father also.
So let that abide (remain) in you which you have heard from the beginning. If what you have heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will continue in the Son, and in the Father.
And this is the promise that He has promised us, even eternal life.
I have written these things to you about those who seduce (lead astray) you.

But the anointing which you have received from Him abides (lives) in you, and you do not need that any man teach you. But as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, you will abide (live) in Him.
And now, little children, abide (live) in Him. Then, when He appears, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before Him at His coming.
If you know that He is righteous (right), you know that every one who does righteousness (what is right) is born of Him.

2.source: Rewritten 2026-11-21 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses. V13-14 keep the KJV's 'I write' / 'I have written' pairs.

verses.text: Look at what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called the sons of God. So the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.
Beloved (dear friends), now we are the sons of God, and it does not yet appear what we will be. But we know that when He appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
And every man who has this hope in Him purifies (makes pure) himself, even as He is pure.
Whoever commits sin transgresses (breaks) also the law. For sin is the transgression (breaking) of the law.
And you know that He was manifested (shown) to take away our sins. And in Him is no sin.
Whoever abides (lives) in Him does not sin. Whoever sins has not seen Him, and has not known Him.
Little children, let no man deceive (fool) you. The one who does righteousness (what is right) is righteous, even as He is righteous.
The one who commits sin is of the devil, for the devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested (shown): that He might destroy the works of the devil.
Whoever is born of God does not commit sin, for God's seed remains in him. And he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

In this the children of God are manifest (shown clearly), and the children of the devil. Whoever does not do righteousness (what is right) is not of God, and neither is the one who does not love his brother.
For this is the message that you heard from the beginning: that we should love one another.
Not like Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew (killed) his brother. And why did Cain kill him? Because Cain's own works were evil, and his brother's were righteous (right).
Do not marvel (be surprised), my brothers, if the world hates you.
We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brothers. The one who does not love his brother abides (stays) in death.
Whoever hates his brother is a murderer. And you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding (living) in him.
By this we perceive (know) the love of God, because He laid down His life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
But whoever has this world's goods, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his bowels of compassion (deep love/tender feelings) from him, how does the love of God dwell (live) in him?
My little children, let us not love in word, or in tongue, but in deed and in truth.
And by this we know that we are of the truth, and will assure (calm) our hearts before Him.
For if our heart condemns (judges guilty) us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
Beloved (dear friends), if our heart does not condemn (judge guilty) us, then we have confidence toward God.
And whatever we ask, we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in His sight.
And this is His commandment: that we should believe on the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as He gave us commandment.
And the one who keeps His commandments dwells (lives) in Him, and He in him. And by this we know that He abides (lives) in us, by the Spirit which He has given us.
Beloved (dear friends), do not believe every spirit. But try (test) the spirits whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God.

And every spirit that does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God. And this is that spirit of antichrist, which you have heard would come. And even now already it is in the world.
You are of God, little children, and have overcome them. Because greater is He who is in you, than he who is in the world.
They are of the world. So they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
We are of God. The one who knows God hears us. The one who is not of God does not hear us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error (wrong).
Beloved (dear friends), let us love one another, for love is of God. And every one who loves is born of God, and knows God.
The one who does not love does not know God, for God is love.
In this the love of God toward us was manifested (shown): God sent His only begotten Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
In this is love: not that we loved God, but that God loved us, and sent His Son to be the propitiation (the sacrifice that turns away God's anger) for our sins.
Beloved (dear friends), if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
No man has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwells (lives) in us, and His love is perfected (made complete) in us.
By this we know that we dwell (live) in God, and He in us, because He has given us of His Spirit.
And we have seen and do testify (tell) that the Father sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.
Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwells (lives) in that person, and that person in God.
And we have known and believed the love that God has for us. God is love. And the one who dwells (lives) in love dwells in God, and God in him.
In this our love is made perfect (complete), so that we may have boldness in the day of judgment. Because as He is, so are we in this world.
There is no fear in love. But perfect love casts out fear, because fear has torment. The one who fears is not made perfect (complete) in love.
We love Him, because He first loved us.
If a man says, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar. For the one who does not love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
And this commandment we have from Him: that the one who loves God love his brother also.

verses.text: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God. And every one who loves the One who begat (gave birth) loves also the one who is begotten (born) of Him.
By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God, and keep His commandments.
For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not grievous (too heavy).
For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith.
Who is the one who overcomes the world, but the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
This is He who came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ. Not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.
For there are three that bear record (witness) in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit. And these three are one.
And there are three that bear witness on earth: the Spirit, and the water, and the blood. And these three agree in one.
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater. For this is the witness of God which He has testified (told) of His Son.
The one who believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself. The one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he does not believe the record (witness) that God gave of His Son.
And this is the record (witness): that God has given to us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
The one who has the Son has life. And the one who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
I have written these things to you who believe on the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life, and so that you may believe on the name of the Son of God.
And this is the confidence that we have in Him: if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
And if we know that He hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions (requests) that we desired of Him.

If any man sees his brother sin a sin which is not to death, he will ask, and God will give him life for those who do not sin to death. There is a sin to death. I do not say that he should pray for it.
All unrighteousness (wrong) is sin. And there is a sin not to death.
We know that whoever is born of God does not sin. But the one who is begotten (born) of God keeps himself, and that wicked one does not touch him.
And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in wickedness.

And we know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, so that we may know Him who is true. And we are in Him who is true, even in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
